problem:
Consider the matrix $A$ given below.
Which entries of $A$ could be replaced by $0$ in order to get a matrix in row echelon form?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 4 & 0 & 9 \\ 0 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -7 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Notice that by replacing ${a}_{22}$, ${a}_{33}$ and ${a}_{44}$ with $0$, we get a matrix in row echelon form:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 4 & 0 & 9 \\ 0 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -7 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 9\end{aligned}]\,⟶\,[\begin{aligned}0 & 4 & 0 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

The other options will not give us a matrix in row echelon form.
